results.title: What is an Executive Membership? - Costco Customer Service
highlights: Costco membership is $65 a year. An Executive Membership is an additional $65 upgrade fee per year. Each includes a free Household Card. Please include sales tax in all applicable states. (Business Members also pay an additional $65 for each additional cardholder - purchases made by the additional cardholders do not contribute towards the 2% Reward.) Members who upgrade for a partial year will be charged a prorated upgrade fee.

results.title: Executive Membership Benefits
highlights: A Costco membership is $65 a year. An Executive Membership is an additional $65 upgrade fee a year. Each membership includes one free Household Card. May be subject to sales tax. Costco accepts all Visa® cards, as well as cash, checks, debit/ATM cards, EBT and Costco Shop Cards. Departments and product selection may vary.

results.title: Membership fees Costco U.S. by type 2026| Statista
highlights: As of February 2026, the annual cost of a Costco's executive membership was 130 U.S. dollars. Meanwhile, a business membership cost 65 U.S. dollars. The executive membership is valid at all Costco locations worldwide, and includes benefits on selected Costco travel products, among other benefits.

results.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation - Costco Wholesale Corporation Reports June Sales Results and Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend and Plans for Membership Fee Increase
highlights: The Company also announced that, effective September 1, 2024, it will increase annual membership fees by $5 for U.S. and Canada Gold Star (individual), Business, and Business add-on members. With this increase, all U.S. and Canada Gold Star, Business and Business add-on members will pay an annual fee of $65. Also effective September 1, annual fees for Executive Memberships in the U.S. and Canada will increase from $120 to $130 (Primary membership of $65, plus the Executive upgrade of $65), and the maximum annual 2% Reward associated with the Executive Membership will increase from $1,000 to $1,250. The fee increases will impact around 52 million memberships, a little over half of which are Executive. Costco currently operates 882 warehouses, including 609 in the United States and Puerto Rico, 108 in Canada, 40 in Mexico, 33 in Japan, 29 in the United Kingdom, 18 in Korea, 15 in Australia, 14 in Taiwan, seven in China, four in Spain, two in France, and one each in Iceland, New Zealand and Sweden. Costco also operates e-commerce sites in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Mexico, Korea, Taiwan, Japan and Australia.

results.title: Is a Costco Membership Worth It?
results.author: Amanda Barroso Lead Writer & Content Strategist
highlights:
Costco charges annual membership fees, which start at $65. In return, members get access to discounted prices on items.
...
| | Gold Star ($65/yr) | Business ($65/yr) | Executive ($130/yr) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Who it's for | Personal use | Business owners | Personal or business |
| Cards included | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Valid at all locations and Costco.com | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Can add extra cardholders | No | +$65/each | +$65/each |
| Early store access | No | No | 1 hr. early (Sun-Fri), 30 min. early (Sat) |
| Annual 2% reward | No | No | Up to $1,250 on qualified purchases |
...
Costco charges a baseline price of $65 just to walk through the door. Spread out that membership cost across a full year, and you’ll need to save $5.42 per month for it to be financially “worth it.”

results.title: Costco Wholesale to hike annual membership fees after seven years
results.author: Granth Vanaik

The annual fee, last raised in June 2017, would increase by $5 to $65 for "gold star" and business members and to $130 from the earlier $120 for executive members, the company said.
...
Costco said the maximum annual 2% reward associated with executive membership will also increase to $1,250 from $1,000.

results.title: Costco’s first membership price hike in 7 years just went into effect | CNN Business
results.author: Jordan Valinsky
highlights: The price of Costco’s premium “Executive Membership” also went up, by $10 to $130 a year. However, those members will soon be able to earn a maximum of $1,250 in rewards annually versus $1,000 currently.

results.title: Costco raises annual membership fees for first time since 2017 | AP News
highlights: The new fees, set to take effect Sept. 1, will boost the price of Costco’s basic Gold Star membership from $60 to $65 annually, while the cost for the premium Executive membership will rise from $120 to $130. The annual fee had remained the same since 2017, despite several years of unusually high inflation rates that finally have been cooling down in recent months.
